title_en: Mosaic: Runtime-Efficient Multi-Agent Embodied Planning
title_zh: Mosaic：运行高效的多智能体具身规划

sentences.en: LLM-based multi-agent embodied planning remains impractical due to prohibitively high execution latency.
sentences.zh: 基于 LLM 的多智能体具身规划因极高的执行延迟而仍不实用。

sentences.en: We identify failed actions as the dominant bottleneck, stemming from two core challenges: inaccurate state tracking under partial observability and inefficient coordination that produces redundant or conflicting actions.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出失败动作为主导瓶颈，它源于两个核心挑战：部分可观测性下不准确的状态跟踪，以及产生冗余或冲突动作的低效协调。

sentences.en: We introduce Mosaic, a runtime-efficient multi-agent planning framework that addresses both challenges.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 Mosaic，一个同时应对这两大挑战的运行高效多智能体规划框架。

sentences.en: Mosaic maintains accurate yet lightweight state tracking through agent-centric semantic memory that stores objects in relative coordinates, enabling geometric transformations and coordination.
sentences.zh: Mosaic 通过以智能体为中心的语义记忆来维持准确而轻量的状态跟踪，该记忆以相对坐标存储物体，从而支持几何变换与协调。

sentences.en: It ensures efficient coordination through Integer Linear Programming that allocates actions at every planning step, enforcing physical feasibility and inter-agent coordination constraints.
sentences.zh: 它通过整数线性规划确保高效协调，在每个规划步骤分配动作，并强制执行物理可行性与智能体间的协调约束。

sentences.en: Across AI2-THOR and search-and-rescue benchmarks, Mosaic achieves 27–32% faster execution, 30–33% fewer LLM calls, 25–31% fewer steps, and 4–10% points higher success rates.
sentences.zh: 在 AI2-THOR 和搜救基准上，Mosaic 实现了 27-32% 更快的执行、30-33% 更少的 LLM 调用、25-31% 更少的步骤，以及高 4-10 个百分点的成功率。

sentences.en: These results demonstrate that efficient memory and constraint-guided coordination are critical for scalable, low-latency multi-agent planning.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，高效记忆与约束引导的协调对于可扩展、低延迟的多智能体规划至关重要。

title_en: Mosaic: Unlocking Over 30$\times$ Context Length for Diffusion LLMs Inference via Global Memory Planning and Dynamic Peak Taming
title_zh: Mosaic：通过全局内存规划与动态峰值抑制，为扩散式 LLM 推理解锁超过 30\times 倍的上下文长度

sentences.en: Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models, leveraging simultaneous denoising to enable global planning and iterative refinement.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散的大语言模型（dLLMs）已成为自回归模型的一种有前景的替代方案，它们利用同步去噪实现全局规划与迭代细化。

sentences.en: These properties make dLLMs attractive for long-context generation.
sentences.zh: 这些特性使 dLLMs 在长上下文生成中颇具吸引力。

sentences.en: However, deploying dLLMs faces a prohibitive memory barrier, as existing inference systems are inefficient for the diffusion paradigm.
sentences.zh: 然而，部署 dLLM 面临一道令人却步的内存壁垒，因为现有推理系统在扩散范式下效率低下。

sentences.en: We observe that current inference systems are misaligned with dLLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到当前的推理系统与 dLLM 并不对齐。

sentences.en: Unlike autoregressive models, whose memory footprint is dominated by the KV-Cache, dLLMs are bottlenecked by transient activations rematerialized per step.
sentences.zh: 与内存占用由 KV-Cache 主导的自回归模型不同，dLLM 的瓶颈在于每步重新物化的瞬时激活。

sentences.en: Moreover, generic memory reuse mechanisms lack the global visibility to handle dynamic memory peaks of dLLMs, which alternate between logits and feed-forward networks.
sentences.zh: 此外，通用的内存复用机制缺乏全局视野，无法处理 dLLM 在 logits 与前馈网络之间交替出现的动态内存峰值。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we present Mosaic, a memory-efficient inference system that shifts dLLM execution from local, static management to a global, dynamic paradigm.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 Mosaic，一个内存高效的推理系统，它将 dLLM 的执行从局部、静态的管理转变为全局、动态的范式。

sentences.en: Mosaic integrates (i) a mask-only logits kernel eliminating redundant activation materialization, (ii) a lazy chunking optimizer using online heuristics to tame dynamic memory peaks, and (iii) a global memory manager leveraging virtual addressing to mitigate memory fragmentation.
sentences.zh: Mosaic 整合了（i）一个仅掩码的 logits 内核，消除冗余的激活物化；（ii）一个使用在线启发式的惰性分块优化器，以抑制动态内存峰值；（iii）一个利用虚拟寻址的全局内存管理器，以缓解内存碎片化。

sentences.en: Evaluations show that Mosaic reduces the memory peak-to-average ratio by 2.71$\times$ on average and increases the maximum inference sequence length on identical hardware by 15.30--32.34$\times$.
sentences.zh: 评估表明，Mosaic 平均将内存峰均比降低了 2.71\times 倍，并在相同硬件上将最大推理序列长度提升了 15.30-32.34\times 倍。

sentences.en: Crucially, Mosaic is training-free and preserves exact model outputs, while reducing end-to-end latency by 2.5\%--55.4\%.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，Mosaic 无需训练且保持精确的模型输出，同时将端到端延迟降低了 2.5\%--55.4\%。

sentences.en: Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/flashserve/Mosaic.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/flashserve/Mosaic 公开获取。

title_en: MoSE: Mixture of Slimmable Experts for Efficient and Adaptive Language Models
title_zh: MoSE：用于高效自适应语言模型的可瘦身专家混合

sentences.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale large language models efficiently by sparsely activating experts, but once an expert is selected, it is executed fully.
sentences.zh: 专家混合（MoE）模型通过稀疏激活专家来高效扩展大语言模型，但一旦选中某个专家，它就会被完全执行。

sentences.en: Hence, the trade-off between accuracy and computation in an MoE model typically exhibits large discontinuities.
sentences.zh: 因此，MoE 模型中准确率与计算之间的权衡通常表现出较大的不连续性。

sentences.en: We propose Mixture of Slimmable Experts (MoSE), an MoE architecture in which each expert has a nested, slimmable structure that can be executed at variable widths.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了可瘦身专家混合（MoSE），一种每个专家都具有嵌套、可瘦身结构、能够以可变宽度执行的 MoE 架构。

sentences.en: This enables conditional computation not only over which experts are activated but also over how much of each expert is utilized.
sentences.zh: 这使得条件计算不仅作用于激活哪些专家，还作用于每个专家被利用的程度。

sentences.en: Consequently, a single pretrained MoSE model can support a more continuous spectrum of accuracy-compute trade-offs at inference time.
sentences.zh: 因此，单个预训练的 MoSE 模型可以在推理时支持更连续的准确率-计算权衡谱。

sentences.en: We present a simple and stable training recipe for slimmable experts under sparse routing, combining multi-width training with standard MoE objectives.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个简单而稳定的、用于稀疏路由下可瘦身专家的训练方案，将多宽度训练与标准 MoE 目标相结合。

sentences.en: During inference, we explore strategies for runtime width determination, including a lightweight test-time training mechanism that learns how to map router confidence/probabilities to expert widths under a fixed budget.
sentences.zh: 在推理时，我们探索运行时宽度确定的策略，包括一种轻量级测试时训练机制，它在固定预算下学习如何将路由置信度/概率映射到专家宽度。

sentences.en: Experiments on GPT-style models, various routing regimes, zero-shot downstream reasoning benchmarks, and continual pre-training adaptation of DeepSeek model show that MoSE matches or improves standard MoE at full width and consistently shifts the compute-quality frontier toward lower inference FLOPs.
sentences.zh: 在 GPT 风格模型、各种路由机制、零样本下游推理基准以及 DeepSeek 模型的持续预训练适配上的实验表明，MoSE 在全宽度下匹配或改进了标准 MoE，并持续将计算-质量前沿推向更低的推理 FLOPs。

sentences.en: The code can be found at: https://github.com/tnurbek/mose.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/tnurbek/mose 获取。

title_en: MoshiRAG: Asynchronous Knowledge Retrieval for Full-Duplex Speech Language Models
title_zh: MoshiRAG：全双工语音语言模型的异步知识检索

sentences.en: Speech-to-speech language models have recently emerged to enhance the naturalness of conversational AI.
sentences.zh: 语音到语音语言模型近期出现，用以增强对话式 AI 的自然度。

sentences.en: In particular, full-duplex models are distinguished by their real-time interactivity, including handling of pauses, interruptions, and backchannels.
sentences.zh: 特别是，全双工模型以其实时交互性而著称，包括处理停顿、打断和反馈语。

sentences.en: However, improving their factuality remains an open challenge.
sentences.zh: 然而，提升它们的事实性仍是一个悬而未决的挑战。

sentences.en: While scaling the model size could address this gap, it would make real-time inference prohibitively expensive.
sentences.zh: 虽然扩大模型规模可以解决这一差距，但这会使实时推理的成本高得令人望而却步。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Moshi-RAG, a modular approach that combines a compact full-duplex interface with selective retrieval to access more powerful knowledge sources.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 Moshi-RAG，一种模块化方法，它将紧凑的全双工接口与选择性检索相结合，以访问更强大的知识源。

sentences.en: Our asynchronous framework enables the model to identify knowledge-demanding queries and ground its responses in external information.
sentences.zh: 我们的异步框架使模型能够识别对知识要求较高的查询，并将其响应建立在外部信息之上。

sentences.en: By leveraging the natural temporal gap between response onset and the delivery of core information, the retrieval process can be completed while maintaining a natural conversation flow.
sentences.zh: 通过利用响应开始与核心信息传递之间天然的时间间隔，检索过程能够在保持自然对话流的同时完成。

sentences.en: With this approach, Moshi-RAG achieves factuality comparable to the best publicly released non-duplex speech language models while preserving the interactivity inherent to full-duplex systems.
sentences.zh: 借助这种方法，Moshi-RAG 在保持全双工系统固有交互性的同时，实现了与最佳公开非双工语音语言模型相当的事实性。

sentences.en: Moreover, our flexible design supports plug-and-play retrieval methods without retraining and demonstrates strong performance on out-of-domain mathematical reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们灵活的设计支持无需重新训练的即插即用检索方法，并在域外数学推理任务上展现出强劲性能。

title_en: MoSSP: A Momentum-Based Single-Loop Stochastic Penalty Method for Nonconvex Constrained DC-regularized Optimization
title_zh: MoSSP：一种用于非凸约束 DC 正则化优化的基于动量的单循环随机惩罚方法

sentences.en: In this paper, we study a structured class of nonconvex constrained stochastic problems with difference-of-convex (DC) regularization, where the feasible set is possibly nonconvex and the concave part of the DC regularizer is allowed to be nonsmooth.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了一类具有凸差（DC）正则化的结构化非凸约束随机问题，其中可行集可能是非凸的，且 DC 正则化的凹部允许非光滑。

sentences.en: The fundamental challenge lies in maintaining feasibility for nonconvex constraints while achieving favorable oracle complexity.
sentences.zh: 根本性挑战在于维持非凸约束的可行性，同时实现良好的预言机复杂度。

sentences.en: Although single-loop algorithms efficiently solve unconstrained DC optimization problems, their potential for constrained optimization with DC structure remains largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然单循环算法能够高效求解无约束 DC 优化问题，但它们在带 DC 结构的约束优化中的潜力在很大程度上仍未被探索。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we develop **MoSSP**, a **Mo**mentum-based **S**ingle-loop **S**tochastic **P**enalty method for such problems with provable complexity guarantees.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一空白，我们开发了 **MoSSP**，一种面向此类问题的**基**于动量的**单**循环**随**机**惩**罚方法，具有可证明的复杂度保证。

sentences.en: The key idea is to apply a single stochastic proximal-gradient step to the Moreau envelope of the penalty plus the convex DC part, with the concave part's proximal mapping computed in parallel.
sentences.zh: 关键在于对"惩罚加上凸 DC 部"的 Moreau 包络应用单步随机近端梯度，同时并行计算凹部的近端映射。

sentences.en: We derive two algorithm variants: a Polyak-momentum version with $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$ oracle complexity for finding stochastic $\varepsilon$-KKT points, and an improved $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$ version incorporating recursive momentum.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出两种算法变体：一个 Polyak 动量版本，具有 $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$ 的预言机复杂度，用于寻找随机 \varepsilon-KKT 点；以及一个纳入递归动量的改进版本，复杂度为 $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.
sentences.zh: 实验结果证明了所提出算法的有效性。

authors.name: Chunfeng Cui
authors.institution: Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

title_en: MoST: Mixing Speech and Text with Modality-Aware Mixture of Experts
title_zh: MoST：以模态感知的专家混合融合语音与文本

sentences.en: We present MoST (Mixture of Speech and Text), a novel multimodal large language  model that seamlessly integrates speech and text processing through our proposed Modality-Aware Mixture of Experts (MAMoE) architecture.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 MoST（语音与文本混合），一种新颖的多模态大语言模型，通过我们提出的模态感知专家混合（MAMoE）架构无缝整合语音与文本处理。

sentences.en: While current multimodal models typically process diverse modality representations with identical parameters—disregarding their inherent representational differences, we introduce specialized routing pathways that direct tokens to modality-appropriate experts based on input type.
sentences.zh: 虽然当前多模态模型通常以相同的参数处理不同的模态表示——忽视了它们固有的表示差异——我们引入了专门的路由通路，根据输入类型将 token 引导到适合模态的专家。

sentences.en: MAMoE simultaneously enhances modality-specific learning and cross-modal understanding through two complementary components: modality-specific expert groups that capture domain-specific patterns and shared experts that facilitate information transfer between modalities.
sentences.zh: MAMoE 通过两个互补组件同时增强模态特定学习与跨模态理解：捕获特定领域模式的模态专属专家组，以及促进模态间信息传递的共享专家。

sentences.en: Building on this architecture, we develop an efficient transformation pipeline that adapts the pretrained MoE language model through strategic post-training on ASR and TTS datasets, followed by fine-tuning with a carefully curated speech-text instruction dataset.
sentences.zh: 基于这一架构，我们开发了一个高效的转换流水线，通过在 ASR 和 TTS 数据集上进行的策略性后训练来适配预训练的 MoE 语言模型，随后用精心策展的语音-文本指令数据集进行微调。

sentences.en: A key feature of this pipeline is that it relies exclusively on fully accessible, open-source datasets to achieve strong performance and data efficiency.
sentences.zh: 该流水线的一个关键特点在于，它仅依赖完全可获取的开源数据集即可实现强劲的性能与数据效率。

sentences.en: Comprehensive evaluations across ASR, TTS, audio language modeling, and spoken question answering benchmarks show that MoST consistently outperforms existing models of comparable parameter counts.
sentences.zh: 在 ASR、TTS、音频语言建模和口语问答基准上的综合评估表明，MoST 一致优于参数规模相当的现有模型。

sentences.en: Our ablation studies confirm that the modality-specific routing mechanism and shared experts design significantly contribute to performance gains across all tested domains.
sentences.zh: 我们的消融研究证实，模态特定路由机制与共享专家设计对所有测试领域的性能提升都有显著贡献。

sentences.en: To our knowledge, MoST represents the first fully open-source speech-text LLM built on a Mixture of Experts architecture.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，MoST 代表了首个完全开源、基于专家混合架构的语音-文本 LLM。

title_en: MotiMotion: Motion-Controlled Video Generation with Visual Reasoning
title_zh: MotiMotion：带视觉推理的运动控制视频生成

sentences.en: Current motion-controlled image-to-video generation models rigidly follow user-provided trajectories that are often sparse, imprecise, and causally incomplete.
sentences.zh: 当前运动控制的图像到视频生成模型死板地遵循用户提供的轨迹，而这些轨迹往往稀疏、不精确且因果上不完整。

sentences.en: Such reliance often yields unnatural or implausible outcomes, especially by missing secondary causal consequences.
sentences.zh: 这种依赖常常产生不自然或不合理的结果，尤其是遗漏了次要的因果后果。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce MotiMotion, a novel framework that reformulates motion control as a reasoning-then-generation problem.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们引入了 MotiMotion，一个将运动控制重新表述为推理-然后-生成问题的新颖框架。

sentences.en: To encourage causally grounded and commonsense-consistent interactions, we leverage a training-free vision-language reasoner to refine image-space coordinates of primary trajectories and to hallucinate plausible secondary motions.
sentences.zh: 为鼓励因果立足且与常识一致的交互，我们利用一个无需训练的视觉-语言推理器来细化主轨迹的图像空间坐标，并幻觉出合理的次要运动。

sentences.en: To further improve motion naturalness, we propose a confidence-aware control scheme that modulates guidance strength, enabling the model to closely follow high-confidence plans while correcting artifacts under low-confidence inputs with its internal generative priors.
sentences.zh: 为进一步提升运动的自然度，我们提出了一种置信度感知的控制方案，它调节引导强度，使模型能够在高置信度计划下紧密跟随，同时在低置信度输入下利用其内部生成先验来修正伪影。

sentences.en: To support systematic evaluation, we curate a new image-to-video benchmark, MotiBench, consisting of interaction-centric scenes where new events are triggered by motion.
sentences.zh: 为支持系统评估，我们策展了一个新的图像到视频基准 MotiBench，包含以交互为中心的场景，其中新事件由运动触发。

sentences.en: Both VLM-based evaluation and a human study on MotiBench demonstrate that MotiMotion produces videos with more plausible object behaviors and interaction, and is preferred over existing approaches.
sentences.zh: 在 MotiBench 上基于 VLM 的评估和人工研究都表明，MotiMotion 生成的视频具有更合理的物体行为与交互，并且优于现有方法。

authors.name: Ming-Hsuan Yang
authors.institution: Google DeepMind; University of California at Merced

title_en: Motion Attribution for Video Generation
title_zh: 视频生成中的运动归因

sentences.en: Despite the rapid progress of video generation models, the role of data in influencing motion is poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 尽管视频生成模型取得了快速进展，但数据在影响运动方面的作用仍未被很好理解。

sentences.en: We present Motive (MOTIon attribution for Video gEneration), a motion-centric, gradient-based data attribution framework that scales to modern, large, high-quality video datasets and models.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 Motive（视频生成的运动归因），一个以运动为中心、基于梯度的数据归因框架，可扩展到现代、大规模、高质量的视频数据集和模型。

sentences.en: We use this to study which fine-tuning clips improve or degrade temporal dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们用它来研究哪些微调片段能够改善或降低时间动态。

sentences.en: Motive isolates temporal dynamics from static appearance via motion-weighted loss masks, yielding efficient and scalable motion-specific influence computation.
sentences.zh: Motive 通过运动加权损失掩码将时间动态与静态外观分离开来，从而提供高效、可扩展的运动特定影响计算。

sentences.en: On text-to-video models, Motive identifies clips that strongly affect motion and guides data curation that improves temporal consistency and physical plausibility.
sentences.zh: 在文本到视频模型上，Motive 识别出强烈影响运动的片段，并指导能够改善时间一致性与物理合理性的数据策展。

sentences.en: With Motive-selected high-influence data, we improve both motion smoothness and dynamic degree on VBench, achieving a 74.1% human preference win rate compared with the pretrained base model.
sentences.zh: 利用 Motive 选择的高影响力数据，我们在 VBench 上同时改善了运动平滑度和动态程度，与预训练基础模型相比实现了 74.1% 的人工偏好胜率。

sentences.en: To our knowledge, this is the first framework to attribute motion rather than visual appearance in video generative models and to use it to curate fine-tuning data.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这是第一个在视频生成模型中归因运动而非视觉外观，并利用它来策展微调数据的框架。

title_en: Motion Dynamics Learning for Few-Shot Embodied Adaptation
title_zh: 用于少样本具身适配的运动动力学学习

sentences.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation, yet adapting pretrained models to novel tasks typically relies on substantial task-specific demonstrations, limiting scalability.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作方面展现出强大的潜力，但将预训练模型适配到新任务通常依赖大量的任务特定演示，这限制了可扩展性。

sentences.en: Current VLA methods mostly focus on action imitation, which ignores the richer structure contained in trajectories.
sentences.zh: 当前的 VLA 方法大多聚焦于动作模仿，而忽视了轨迹中蕴含的更丰富结构。

sentences.en: In contrast, motion dynamics governing how actions evolve over time are more informative and transferable, making them better suited for few-shot adaptation.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，控制动作如何随时间演变的运动动力学更具信息量且更易迁移，因此更适合少样本适配。

sentences.en: Motivated by this idea, we propose DynVLA, a few-shot adaptation system that reformulates VLA learning from action imitation to trajectory-level motion dynamics modeling.
sentences.zh: 受这一想法的启发，我们提出了 DynVLA，一个将 VLA 学习从动作模仿重构为轨迹级运动动力学建模的少样本适配系统。

sentences.en: Specifically, we propose Motion Dynamics Mechanism (MDM), which distills latent embeddings from trajectories via flow-matching inversion, yielding compact representations that capture dynamics.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们提出了运动动力学机制（MDM），它通过流匹配反演从轨迹中蒸馏潜在嵌入，产生捕获动力学的紧凑表示。

sentences.en: We further design Dynamics-Constrained Modeling (DCM).
sentences.zh: 我们进一步设计了动力学约束建模（DCM）。

sentences.en: DCM projects these inferred representations onto a Dynamics Bank, which stores prior motion knowledge pretrained from diverse demonstrations.
sentences.zh: DCM 将推断出的这些表示投影到动力学库上，该库存储了从多样化演示中预训练的先验运动知识。

sentences.en: By grounding action generation in these learned priors, the system enables interpolating between existing action paradigms to represent novel dynamics modes.
sentences.zh: 通过将动作生成立足在这些学习到的先验之上，系统能够在现有动作范式之间插值，以表示新颖的动力学模式。

sentences.en: Experiments on 13 real-world tasks demonstrate that DynVLA outperforms existing SOTA systems by 15.8\% in average success rate with around 20 demonstrations, highlighting its adaptation capabilities in real-world scenes.
sentences.zh: 在 13 个真实世界任务上的实验表明，在大约 20 个演示下，DynVLA 在平均成功率上比现有 SOTA 系统高出 15.8\%，凸显了它在真实世界场景中的适配能力。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/trantor2nd/Motion-DynVLA.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/trantor2nd/Motion-DynVLA 获取。

title_en: Motion Planning in Compressed Representation Spaces
title_zh: 压缩表示空间中的运动规划

sentences.en: Deep learning methods have vastly expanded the capabilities of motion planning in robotics applications, as learning priors from large-scale data has been shown to be essential in capturing the highly complex behavior required for solving tasks such as manipulation or navigation for autonomous vehicles.
sentences.zh: 深度学习方法极大地扩展了机器人应用中运动规划的能力，因为从大规模数据中学习先验已被证明对于捕获解决操作或自动驾驶车辆导航等任务所需的高度复杂行为至关重要。

sentences.en: At the same time, model-based planning algorithms based on search or optimization remain an essential tool due to their flexibility, efficiency, and the ability to incorporate domain knowledge via expert-designed algorithms and objective functions.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，基于搜索或优化的模型规划算法由于其灵活性、效率以及通过专家设计的算法和目标函数融入领域知识的能力，仍然是必不可少的工具。

sentences.en: We propose a new generative framework to unify these two paradigms.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个新的生成式框架来统一这两种范式。

sentences.en: First, we learn an autoencoder with a high compression ratio and a latent space of hierarchically ordered, discrete-valued tokens.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们学习一个具有高压缩比的自编码器，其潜在空间由层次有序的离散值 token 组成。

sentences.en: Leveraging both the dimensionality reduction and the hierarchical coarse-to-fine structure learned by this autoencoder, we then perform motion planning by directly searching in the latent space of tokens.
sentences.zh: 利用该自编码器学习到的降维与层次化粗到细结构，我们随后直接在 token 的潜在空间中进行搜索来执行运动规划。

sentences.en: This search can optimize arbitrary objective functions specified at test time, providing a large degree of flexibility while maintaining efficiency and producing realistic solutions by relying on the generative capabilities of the highly compressed autoencoder.
sentences.zh: 这种搜索可以优化测试时指定的任意目标函数，提供很大的灵活性，同时保持效率，并通过依赖高压缩自编码器的生成能力来产生逼真的解。

sentences.en: We evaluate our method on nuPlan and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, showing how latent space search can be used for a variety of guided behavior generation tasks, achieving strong performance for closed-loop motion planning and multi-agent guided scenario synthesis without requiring any task-specific training.
sentences.zh: 我们在 nuPlan 和 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上评估了我们的方法，展示了潜在空间搜索可用于各种引导式行为生成任务，在无需任何任务特定训练的情况下，为闭环运动规划和多智能体引导式场景合成取得了强劲的性能。

title_en: Motion-Aware Caching for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
title_zh: 面向高效自回归视频生成的运动感知缓存

sentences.en: Autoregressive video generation paradigms offer theoretical promise for long video synthesis, yet their practical deployment is hindered by the computational burden of sequential iterative denoising.
sentences.zh: 自回归视频生成范式为长视频合成提供了理论前景，然而其实际部署受到顺序迭代去噪的计算负担的阻碍。

sentences.en: While cache reuse strategies can accelerate generation by skipping redundant denoising steps, existing methods rely on coarse-grained chunk-level skipping that fails to capture fine-grained pixel dynamics.
sentences.zh: 虽然缓存复用策略可以通过跳过冗余去噪步骤来加速生成，但现有方法依赖无法捕获细粒度像素动态的粗粒度块级跳过。

sentences.en: This oversight is critical: pixels with high motion require more denoising steps to prevent error accumulation, while static pixels tolerate aggressive skipping.
sentences.zh: 这一忽视是关键的：高运动像素需要更多的去噪步骤以防止误差累积，而静态像素则可以容忍激进的跳过。

sentences.en: We formalize this insight theoretically by linking cache errors to residual instability, and propose $\textbf{MotionCache}$, a motion-aware cache framework that exploits inter-frame differences as a lightweight proxy for pixel-level motion characteristics.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将缓存误差与残差不稳定联系起来，从理论上形式化了这一洞见，并提出了 \textbf{MotionCache}，一种利用帧间差异作为像素级运动特征轻量代理的运动感知缓存框架。

sentences.en: MotionCache employs a coarse-to-fine strategy: an initial warm-up phase establishes semantic coherence, followed by motion-weighted cache reuse that dynamically adjusts update frequencies per token.
sentences.zh: MotionCache 采用粗到细的策略：初始预热阶段建立语义连贯性，随后进行运动加权缓存复用，动态调整每个 token 的更新频率。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art models like SkyReels-V2 and MAGI-1 demonstrate that MotionCache achieves significant speedups of $\textbf{6.28}\times$ and $\textbf{1.64}\times$ respectively, while effectively preserving generation quality (VBench: 1%$\downarrow$ and 0.01%$\downarrow$ respectively).
sentences.zh: 在 SkyReels-V2 和 MAGI-1 等最先进模型上的大量实验表明，MotionCache 分别实现了 \textbf{6.28}\times 和 \textbf{1.64}\times 的显著加速，同时有效保持生成质量（VBench 分别下降 1% 和 0.01%）。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/ywlq/MotionCache.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/ywlq/MotionCache 获取。

title_en: Motion-Residual Conflict-Aware Time Reversal for Generative Inbetweening
title_zh: 用于生成式补间（inbetweening）的运动残差冲突感知时间反转

sentences.en: Image-to-video (I2V) diffusion models have recently made generative inbetweening a practical reality by synthesizing semantically plausible intermediate frames between two keyframes.
sentences.zh: 图像到视频（I2V）扩散模型近期通过合成两个关键帧之间语义合理的中间帧，使生成式补间成为现实。

sentences.en: Among them, inference-time sampling schemes that re-use large pre-trained I2V backbones without any additional training are especially attractive.
sentences.zh: 其中，重复使用大型预训练 I2V 骨干而无需任何额外训练的推理时采样方案尤其具有吸引力。

sentences.en: Yet current methods frequently exhibit temporal inconsistency and artifacts such as ghosting or reverse motion.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前方法经常表现出时间不一致以及鬼影或反向运动等伪影。

sentences.en: A key reason is that the two trajectories are driven by distinct motion priors, each inherited from its own conditioning frame, and are simply stitched together without explicitly reconciling these priors.
sentences.zh: 一个关键原因在于，两条轨迹由不同的运动先验驱动，每条轨迹从各自的调节帧继承而来，并被简单拼接在一起，而没有显式地调和这些先验。

sentences.en: We introduce Motion-Residual Conflict-Aware Time Reversal (MR‑CATR), an inference-time sampling framework that aligns conflicting motion priors instead of discarding one of them or collapsing to a single start-conditioned prior.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了运动残差冲突感知时间反转（MR-CATR），一个推理时采样框架，它对齐冲突的运动先验，而不是丢弃其中一个或坍缩为单一的首帧条件先验。

sentences.en: MR‑CATR first derives a motion-residual–based direction from the forward path, combined with an end-conditioned residual to form a consensus motion axis.
sentences.zh: MR-CATR 首先从前向路径推导出一个基于运动残差的方向，并结合端条件残差以形成共识运动轴。

sentences.en: This design suppresses bidirectional motion conflicts while still allowing end-frame information to refine the trajectory and enforce endpoint consistency.
sentences.zh: 这种设计抑制了双向运动冲突，同时仍允许端帧信息细化轨迹并强制端点一致性。

sentences.en: MR‑CATR can be seamlessly integrated into existing time-reversal samplers without changing model parameters.
sentences.zh: MR-CATR 可以无缝集成到现有的时间反转采样器中，而无需改变模型参数。

sentences.en: Experiments on generative inbetweening benchmarks show that our method produces videos with smoother motion, fewer artifacts, and consistently better quantitative scores and user preferences than prior strategies.
sentences.zh: 在生成式补间基准上的实验表明，与先前策略相比，我们的方法生成的视频运动更平滑、伪影更少，并在定量分数和用户偏好上持续更优。

title_en: MotionGRPO: Overcoming Low Intra-Group Diversity in GRPO-Based Egocentric Motion Recovery
title_zh: MotionGRPO：克服基于 GRPO 的自我中心运动恢复中组内多样性过低的问题

sentences.en: This paper studies full-body 3D human motion recovery from head-mounted device signals.
sentences.zh: 本文研究从头戴式设备信号中恢复全身 3D 人体运动。

sentences.en: Existing diffusion-based methods often rely on global distribution matching, leading to local joint reconstruction errors.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于扩散的方法常常依赖全局分布匹配，导致局部关节重建误差。

sentences.en: We propose MotionGRPO, a novel framework leveraging reinforcement learning post-training to inject fine-grained guidance into the diffusion process.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 MotionGRPO，一个利用强化学习后训练为扩散过程注入细粒度引导的新颖框架。

sentences.en: Technically, we model diffusion sampling as a Markov decision process optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).
sentences.zh: 在技术层面，我们将扩散采样建模为通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）优化的马尔可夫决策过程。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce a hybrid reward mechanism that combines a learned conditioned perceptual model for global visual plausibility and explicit constraints for local joint precision.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入了一种混合奖励机制，它结合了一个用于全局视觉合理性的学习到的条件感知模型，以及用于局部关节精度的显式约束。

sentences.en: Our key technical insight is that policy optimization in diffusion-based recovery suffers from vanishing gradients due to limited intra-group sample diversity.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键技术洞见在于，基于扩散的恢复中的策略优化因组内样本多样性有限而遭受梯度消失。

sentences.en: To address this, we further introduce a noise-injection strategy that explicitly increases sample variance and stabilizes learning.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们进一步引入了一种噪声注入策略，它显式地增加样本方差并稳定学习。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotionGRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior visual fidelity.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证明，MotionGRPO 以卓越的视觉保真度取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Code is available at: https://github.com/3DAgentWorld/MotionGRPO/
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/3DAgentWorld/MotionGRPO/ 获取。

title_en: MotionMAR: Multi-scale Auto-Regressive Human Motion Reconstruction from Sparse Observations
title_zh: MotionMAR：从稀疏观测中进行多尺度自回归人体运动重建

sentences.en: Human motion follows a temporal hierarchical structure, transitioning from low-frequency global trajectories to high-frequency details.
sentences.zh: 人体运动遵循时间层次结构，从低频全局轨迹过渡到高频细节。

sentences.en: Inspired by the success of multi-level autoregressive models in computer vision, we propose MotionMAR, a coarse-to-fine framework for motion reconstruction from sparse observations.
sentences.zh: 受计算机视觉中多层自回归模型成功的启发，我们提出了 MotionMAR，一个从稀疏观测中重建运动的粗到细框架。

sentences.en: It first estimates the global trajectory of human motion and then gradually refines the temporal details.
sentences.zh: 它首先估计人体运动的全局轨迹，然后逐步细化时间细节。

sentences.en: This architecture consists of four integrated components.
sentences.zh: 这一架构由四个集成组件构成。

sentences.en: The Temporal Multi-scale Tokenization (TMT) VQ-VAE encodes the data at multiple temporal resolutions, separating semantic motion from minor jitters.
sentences.zh: 时间多尺度分词（TMT）VQ-VAE 在多个时间分辨率下对数据进行编码，将语义运动与细微抖动分离开来。

sentences.en: The Motion Autoregressive Network (MAN) operates in this latent space, predicting motion across scales.
sentences.zh: 运动自回归网络（MAN）在这一潜在空间中运作，跨尺度预测运动。

sentences.en: It first establishes the global structure through coarse indices and then generates finer indices to recover specific details.
sentences.zh: 它首先通过粗索引建立全局结构，然后生成更细的索引以恢复具体细节。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the Scale-Aware Control (SAC) module integrates sparse tracking data to ensure the generated output aligns with actual observations.
sentences.zh: 同时，尺度感知控制（SAC）模块整合稀疏跟踪数据，确保生成的输出与实际观测对齐。

sentences.en: The Motion Refinement Network (MRN) subsequently smooths consecutive poses and eliminates quantization artifacts.
sentences.zh: 运动细化网络（MRN）随后平滑连续姿态并消除量化伪影。

sentences.en: Experiments show that MotionMAR achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the AMASS dataset, providing a reliable and structure-aware approach for motion reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，MotionMAR 在 AMASS 数据集上取得了最先进的准确率，为运动重建提供了一种可靠且结构感知的方法。

sentences.en: The source code is publicly available at \url{http://www.lidarhumanmotion.net/motionmar/}.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 \url{http://www.lidarhumanmotion.net/motionmar/} 公开获取。

title_en: Move-Then-Operate: Behavioral Phasing for Human-Like Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: 先移动再操作：面向类人机器人操作的阶段性行为划分

sentences.en: We present Move-Then-Operate, a Vision–language–action framework that explicitly decouples robotic manipulation into two distinct behavioral phases: coarse relocation (move) and contact-critical interaction (operate).
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 Move-Then-Operate，一个视觉-语言-动作框架，将机器人操作显式地解耦为两个不同的行为阶段：粗略移动（move）和接触关键交互（operate）。

sentences.en: Unlike monolithic policies that conflate these heterogeneous regimes, our architecture employs a dual-expert policy routed by a learnable phase selector, introducing a structural inductive bias that isolates phase-specific dynamics.
sentences.zh: 与将这些异构机制混为一谈的整体式策略不同，我们的架构采用由可学习的阶段选择器路由的双专家策略，引入了隔离各阶段特定动态的结构性归纳偏置。

sentences.en: Phase labels are automatically generated via an MLLM-based pipeline conditioned on lightweight contextual cues such as end-effector velocity and subtask decomposition to ensure alignment with human motor patterns.
sentences.zh: 阶段标签通过一个以轻量级上下文线索（如末端执行器速度和子任务分解）为条件、基于 MLLM 的流水线自动生成，以确保与人类运动模式对齐。

sentences.en: Evaluated on the RoboTwin2 benchmark, our method achieves an average success rate of $68.9\%$, outperforming the monolithic $\pi_0$ baseline by +$24\%$.
sentences.zh: 在 RoboTwin2 基准上的评估表明，我们的方法实现了 $68.9\%$ 的平均成功率，比整体式 \pi_0 基线高出 +$24\%$。

sentences.en: It matches or exceeds models trained on $10\times$ more data and reaches peak performance in $40\%$ fewer training steps, demonstrating that architectural disentanglement of move and operate phases is a highly effective and efficient strategy for mastering high-precision manipulation.
sentences.zh: 它与用 $10\times$ 更多数据训练的模型相当甚至更优，并在训练步数少 $40\%$ 的情况下达到峰值性能，这表明移动与操作阶段架构上的解耦是掌握高精度操作的一种高效且有效的策略。

title_en: MoVie: Multimodal Video Compression with Text Guidance
title_zh: MoVie：带文本引导的多模态视频压缩

sentences.en: Most deep video codecs emphasize low-level motion modeling and remain largely semantics-agnostic, which can degrade perceptual quality in complex scenes.
sentences.zh: 大多数深度视频编解码器强调低层运动建模，在很大程度上与语义无关，这在复杂场景中可能降低感知质量。

sentences.en: We propose **MoVie**, a **M**ultim**o**dal **Vi**d**e**o compression framework built on a Text-guided Video Transformer–CNN Mixed block (*Text-VideoTCM*).
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 **MoVie**，一个建立在文本引导的视频 Transformer-CNN 混合模块（*Text-VideoTCM*）之上的**多**（**M**ultim**o**dal）**视**（**Vi**d**e**o）频压缩框架。

sentences.en: MoVie adopts a video-centric architecture that jointly models local spatial structures and temporal dynamics via window-based processing, delivering a favorable computation--perception trade-off.
sentences.zh: MoVie 采用以视频为中心的架构，通过基于窗口的处理联合建模局部空间结构与时间动态，实现了良好的计算-感知权衡。

sentences.en: To incorporate semantics, we introduce dual-stage text fusion with *Extractor* and *Injector* modules.
sentences.zh: 为融入语义，我们引入了带 *Extractor*（提取器）和 *Injector*（注入器）模块的双阶段文本融合。

sentences.en: We further present history-conditioned coding that leverages both previous and aggregated historical frames, and a spatial--channel factorized entropy model that estimates probabilities over spatial neighborhoods and channel groups for adaptive bit allocation.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出了历史条件编码，利用先前与聚合的历史帧，以及一种空间-通道因式分解熵模型，该模型在空间邻域和通道组上估计概率，以实现自适应比特分配。

sentences.en: Together, these designs reduce redundancy and improve rate control and temporal coherence, yielding reconstructions at low bitrates.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这些设计减少了冗余，并改善了码率控制和时间连贯性，从而在低码率下获得重建结果。

sentences.en: On UVG and MCL-JCV, MoVie achieves **$-$50.23\%** BD-rate for FID and **$-$14.64\%** for LPIPS (VGGNet) relative to HM, while requiring only **55.76\%** of DCVC-FM's per-pixel kMACs.
sentences.zh: 在 UVG 和 MCL-JCV 上，相对于 HM，MoVie 在 FID 上实现了 **$-$50.23\%**、在 LPIPS（VGGNet）上实现了 **$-$14.64\%** 的 BD-rate，而仅需 DCVC-FM 每像素 kMACs 的 **55.76\%**。

sentences.en: A human perceptual study further confirms consistent subjective preference over strong baselines.
sentences.zh: 一项人类感知研究进一步确认了相对强基线的持续主观偏好。

title_en: Moving Out: Physically-grounded Human-AI Collaboration
title_zh: 移动搬出：基于物理的人类-AI 协作

sentences.en: The ability to adapt to physical actions and constraints in an environment is crucial for embodied agents (e.g., robots) to effectively collaborate with humans.
sentences.zh: 适应环境中物理动作和约束的能力，对于具身智能体（如机器人）与人类有效协作至关重要。

sentences.en: Such physically grounded human-AI collaboration must account for the increased complexity of the continuous state-action space and constrained dynamics caused by physical constraints.
sentences.zh: 这种基于物理的人类-AI 协作必须考虑到连续状态-动作空间以及由物理约束导致的约束动力学所带来的更高复杂性。

sentences.en: However, most existing collaboration benchmarks are discrete or do not consider physical attributes and constraints.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有协作基准是离散的，或者不考虑物理属性与约束。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce Moving Out, a human-AI collaboration benchmark that resembles a wide range of collaboration modes affected by physical attributes and constraints, such as moving heavy items together and coordinating actions to move an item around a corner.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们引入了 Moving Out，一个受物理属性与约束影响、涵盖多种协作模式的人类-AI 协作基准，例如一起搬运重物、以及协调动作将物品移过拐角。

sentences.en: Moving Out consists of two challenges and human-human interaction data to comprehensively evaluate models' abilities to adapt to diverse human behaviors and unseen physical attributes.
sentences.zh: Moving Out 包含两个挑战和人类-人类交互数据，以全面评估模型适应多样化人类行为与未见物理属性的能力。

sentences.en: To give embodied agents the capability to collaborate with humans under physical attributes and constraints, we propose a novel method, BASS (Behavior Augmentation, Simulation, and Selection), to enhance the diversity of agents and their understanding of the outcome of actions.
sentences.zh: 为赋予具身智能体在物理属性与约束下与人类协作的能力，我们提出了一种新颖方法 BASS（行为增广、仿真与选择），以增强智能体的多样性及其对动作结果的理解。

sentences.en: We systematically compare BASS and state-of-the-art models in AI-AI and human-AI experiments, showing that BASS can effectively collaborate with both unseen AI and humans.
sentences.zh: 我们在 AI-AI 和人类-AI 实验中系统地比较了 BASS 与最先进模型，表明 BASS 能够有效地与未见的 AI 和人类进行协作。

title_en: MPFM: Cross Multi-Domain Prototype Flow Matching for Log Anomaly Detection
title_zh: MPFM：用于日志异常检测的跨多领域原型流匹配

sentences.en: Cross multi-domain log anomaly detection aims to train a unified model applying in multiple heterogeneous systems, alleviating the annotation cost and scalability bottlenecks of traditional cross single-domain approaches.
sentences.zh: 跨多领域日志异常检测旨在训练一个可应用于多个异构系统的统一模型，从而缓解传统跨单领域方法面临的标注成本与可扩展性瓶颈。

sentences.en: However, existing methods face two fundamental challenges: (i) geometric proximity alone is insufficient to certify normality, and (ii) forcibly aligning distributions across domains can induce negative transfer.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法面临两个根本性挑战：（i）仅凭几何邻近不足以证明正常性；（ii）强制对齐各领域间分布可能引发负迁移。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose MPFM (Cross Multi-Domain Prototype Flow Matching for Log Anomaly Detection), grounded in the principle that anomalies are samples that cannot be stably generated by the normal data-generating mechanism.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出了 MPFM（用于日志异常检测的跨多领域原型流匹配），其原则是：异常是不能被正常数据生成机制稳定生成的样本。

sentences.en: Specifically, MPFM employs a shared–private prototype system to disentangle cross-domain commonalities from domain-specific patterns, introduces domain-conditioned flow matching to perform anomaly detection by integrating structural and dynamical evidence, and further leverages prototype-drift-driven hard example mining to improve robustness near decision boundaries.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，MPFM 采用共享-私有原型系统，将跨领域共性从领域特定模式中解耦；引入领域条件的流匹配，通过整合结构与动态证据进行异常检测；并进一步利用原型漂移驱动的难例挖掘以提升决策边界附近的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Experiments on HDFS, BGL, Thunderbird, and Spirit demonstrate that MPFM delivers substantial gains under multi-domain joint training.
sentences.zh: 在 HDFS、BGL、Thunderbird 和 Spirit 上的实验表明，MPFM 在多领域联合训练下带来了可观的收益。

title_en: MRPO: Magnitude-Regularized Policy Optimization via L1 Constraints
title_zh: MRPO：通过 L1 约束进行幅度正则化策略优化

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) relies on imperfect reward supervision, necessitating constraints on policy updates to prevent overfitting.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的强化学习（RL）依赖不完美的奖励监督，因此需要通过约束策略更新来防止过拟合。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the widely adopted KL constraint over-penalizes actions with low reference probabilities and lacks the sparsity to discard marginal policy shifts.
sentences.zh: 然而，广泛采用的 KL 约束对参考概率较低的动作过度惩罚，并且缺乏舍弃边际策略偏移的稀疏性。

sentences.en: In contrast, the L1-norm offers a distinct mechanism that is more tolerant of low-probability actions yet strictly suppresses minor probability perturbations.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，L1 范数提供了一种独特的机制，它对低概率动作更为宽容，却严格抑制微小的概率扰动。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we propose Magnitude-Regularized Policy Optimization (MRPO), which enforces an L1-norm constraint on policy updates.
sentences.zh: 受此启发，我们提出了幅度正则化策略优化（MRPO），它在策略更新上施加 L1 范数约束。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that MRPO permits substantial probability boosts for low-probability actions and induces sparse updates, ensuring invariance to noise that preserves the top-ranking order.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，MRPO 允许低概率动作获得可观的概率提升，并引发稀疏更新，从而确保对保持排序顺序的不变性（对噪声鲁棒）。

sentences.en: Furthermore, MRPO admits a TRPO-style monotonic improvement bound under standard regularity assumptions and achieves a tighter approach to optimality than KL-based methods in single-step scenarios.
sentences.zh: 此外，MRPO 在标准正则性假设下具有 TRPO 式的单调改进界，并在单步场景中比基于 KL 的方法实现更接近最优的逼近。

sentences.en: Empirically, MRPO delivers exceptional results across diverse scenarios, notably doubling the performance gains of GRPO in preference alignment, outperforming DAPO in mathematical reasoning, and surpassing DPO in offline settings using only binary rewards.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，MRPO 在多种场景中取得了卓越的结果，尤其是在偏好对齐中将 GRPO 的性能收益翻倍、在数学推理中优于 DAPO、并在仅使用二元奖励的离线设置中超过 DPO。

title_en: mSOP-765k: A Benchmark For Multi-Modal Structured Output Predictions
title_zh: mSOP-765k：一个用于多模态结构化输出预测的基准

sentences.en: This paper introduces mSOP-765k, a large-scale benchmark for the evaluation of multi-modal Structured Output Prediction (mSOP) pipelines.
sentences.zh: 本文介绍了 mSOP-765k，一个用于评估多模态结构化输出预测（mSOP）流水线的大规模基准。

sentences.en: Besides novel evaluation metrics, the benchmark provides combined training and test datasets with over 765,000 images taken from real-world product advertisements.
sentences.zh: 除了新颖的评估指标外，该基准还提供了组合的训练与测试数据集，包含 765,000 多张来自真实世界产品广告的图像。

sentences.en: Each of these images contains product visualizations, textual information like product name or brand, and numerical data such as product weight, price, and discount.
sentences.zh: 这些图像中的每一张都包含产品可视化、产品名称或品牌等文本信息，以及产品重量、价格和折扣等数值数据。

sentences.en: All images are annotated with the corresponding structured information in form of dictionaries containing key-value pairs.
sentences.zh: 所有图像都标注了相应的结构化信息，形式为包含键值对的字典。

sentences.en: An initial baseline evaluation, including various LLMs and VLMs, as well as multi-modal RAG approaches, shows that the proposed benchmark provides a challenging problem which can not yet be solved completely by state-of-the-art mSOP methods.
sentences.zh: 一项包括各种 LLM 和 VLM 以及多模态 RAG 方法的初始基线评估表明，所提出的基准构成一个有挑战性的问题，目前最先进的 mSOP 方法尚无法完全解决。

sentences.en: The benchmark and dataset are available under a creative-commons license: https://www.msop-765k.org/
sentences.zh: 该基准和数据集以知识共享许可提供：https://www.msop-765k.org/

title_en: MSP: Probabilistically Consistent Multi-Scale Action Generation
title_zh: MSP：概率一致的多尺度动作生成

sentences.en: In robotic imitation learning, accurately modeling the multimodality and temporal correlations of long-horizon action sequences remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 在机器人模仿学习中，精确建模长时程动作序列的多模态性与时间相关性仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Long-horizon tasks require preserving global task intent while executing precise low-level control; otherwise, local errors can accumulate and lead to failure.
sentences.zh: 长时程任务要求在执行精确的低层控制的同时保持全局任务意图；否则，局部误差可能累积并导致失败。

sentences.en: While recent coarse-to-fine autoregressive models have improved action generation, they struggle to maintain consistency across hierarchies, leading to suboptimal performance in long-horizon tasks.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期粗到细的自回归模型改进了动作生成，但它们难以在层级间保持一致性，导致长时程任务性能欠佳。

sentences.en: To address these shortcomings, we propose Probabilistically Consistent Multi-Scale Action Generation (MSP), a novel coarse-to-fine approach that promotes cross-scale consistency.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些不足，我们提出了概率一致的多尺度动作生成（MSP），一种促进跨尺度一致性的新颖粗到细方法。

sentences.en: MSP adopts a streamlined multi-scale design by directly downsampling in a continuous latent space.
sentences.zh: MSP 采用简化的多尺度设计，直接在连续潜在空间中进行降采样。

sentences.en: A scale-wise autoregressive Transformer is used to generate semantic conditions at each scale, which guide a lightweight MeanFlow model to capture multi-scale latent distributions, enabling probabilistically consistent refinement across scales.
sentences.zh: 使用一个逐尺度的自回归 Transformer 在每个尺度生成语义条件，这些条件引导一个轻量级 MeanFlow 模型捕获多尺度潜在分布，从而在不同尺度间实现概率一致的细化。

sentences.en: Through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, including long-horizon, multi-task, and few-shot generalization settings, we show that MSP outperforms existing coarse-to-fine methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance with high efficiency.
sentences.zh: 通过包括长时程、多任务和少样本泛化设置在内的大量仿真与真实世界实验，我们表明 MSP 优于现有粗到细方法，以高效率取得最先进性能。

sentences.en: Our code will be publicly available upon publication.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码将在发表后公开。

title_en: MTNL: A Unified Modeling Perspective for Enhancing Tensor Network Learning
title_zh: MTNL：增强张量网络学习的统一建模视角

sentences.en: Over the years, the unsupervised and supervised learning research directions of tensor networks (TNs) have mainly developed in parallel.
sentences.zh: 多年来，张量网络（TNs）的无监督与监督学习研究方向主要是并行发展的。

sentences.en: In this paper, we provide a view for their cooperative advancement through a novel mixed tensor network learning (MTNL) framework that unifies the two fields.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过一个统一了这两个领域的新颖混合张量网络学习（MTNL）框架，为它们的协同推进提供了一种视角。

sentences.en: Specifically, inspired by supervised TN learning tasks, multiple TNs are fused in a deep-network style in MTNL, enhancing the expressive power for the unsupervised TN learning tasks.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，受监督 TN 学习任务的启发，MTNL 以深度网络的方式融合多个 TN，从而增强无监督 TN 学习任务的表达能力。

sentences.en: We then develop a more flexible TN structure search prior with theoretical guarantees for learning multiple TN structures, aligning with trends in many supervised learning setups.
sentences.zh: 我们随后为学习多个 TN 结构开发了一种更灵活、且有理论保证的 TN 结构搜索先验，与许多监督学习设置的趋势保持一致。

sentences.en: More interestingly, by combining these components within a Bayesian framework, we show that MTNL induces a lightweight uncertainty quantification mechanism that is theoretically guaranteed by its connection to the dropout-based counterpart problem, making the mechanism a potential alternative for large-scale learning problems.
sentences.zh: 更有趣的是，通过将这些组件结合在贝叶斯框架内，我们表明 MTNL 产生了一种轻量级的不确定性量化机制，该机制通过其与基于 dropout 的对应问题之间的联系而获得理论保证，使其可能成为大规模学习问题的一种替代方案。

sentences.en: Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the MTNL framework on tensor recovery, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and tensor regression experiments.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在张量恢复、参数高效微调和张量回归实验上展示了 MTNL 框架的有效性。
